entry.title: New: Dep Audit
entry.summary: Dependency supply-chain hygiene audit for DeepSeek Harness: peer-range resolvability, broken dist-tag detection (#2763 class), stale/missing-license/non-registry deps, and installed-vs-declared drift. CLI + agent-callable dep_audit tool with dsh-dep-audit/v1 reports. Exact install spec: dsh-dep-audit. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: listed.
